The *Dutiyanāgavimānavatthu* ("Second Elephant Mansion", Vv 61) is a canonical verse text in the *Vimānavatthu*. In this discourse, a deva describes the heavenly rewards and spiritual benefits resulting from having observed the five precepts during life.
